recap: Day 10, two tribes, two torches snuffed — and a twist that cracked this game wide open. Toka rolled to immunity and pastries, but the note at camp meant somebody had to give up the sweets for a journey, and the random draw spit out Maggie. She turned that trip into the move of the season: she handed her gifted extra vote AND the extra vote she'd snatched away to Lewis and Kilby over on Dina. Savu went first, and after a night of real, raw storytelling around the fire, the helicopter alliance held firm and Alexis went out 3-1. Then Dina detonated. Four votes Linnea, four votes Lewis, a deadlock, and Kilby standing ten toes down, ready to draw rocks. Eric folded. Sharonda folded. Cristian folded. Linnea went home by consensus — so stunned she walked up without her torch. That, family, is a cross-tribal blindside.
bullets: Maggie never cast a vote on Dina and still ran that Tribal Council from across the water.
Lewis tried to sell Sharonda a "blood ring" idol — until Cristian remembered he'd already explained the ring's real meaning weeks ago.
Kilby could have pocketed an extra vote and let Lewis walk; he burned the easy road instead.
Alexis arrived to that alliance a week late and couldn't beat a Day 1 bond — out 3-1.
Savu strong held together right up until rocks were on the table, and then it folded three times in a row.
draftImpact: Tim, you are untouchable tonight — 20 to 28, all four of yours still standing, and Maggie's masterclass put you on top. Tami, 18 to 24 with three of five alive, and Rob doesn't even count against you under best-four. Austin, 19 to 24 is a solid night, but you lost Linnea in that rock standoff and you're down to two. Taylor, 16 to 22, three of four breathing. Kylie, 15 to 19 — Alexis is gone, and you're holding two. Tim leads at 28.
